next_question.question: What observable standard should define “fully proficient on day one” across the listed capabilities?

turns.manager_message: Honestly they're all mandatory, this is a technical role. But if you're forcing me to pick, Python, SQL, and basic REST API debugging are what they'll touch in week one. The machine-learning, generative-AI, and cloud infrastructure stack can ramp up over the first couple of months with mentoring. The Scrum, budget forecasting, and presentation skills are just nice to have, not required.

next_question.question: Which skills must an intern already be able to perform independently on day one, and what observable proficiency level is required for each?

turns.manager_message: Only three are day-one requirements: independently write and debug a small Python data-processing script, query existing warehouse tables with SQL, and trace a REST API 4xx or 5xx response using logs and documentation. Every other listed technology is learnable after joining and is preferred rather than mandatory; Scrum, budget forecasting, and presentations are optional.

next_question.question: Do “every other listed technology” and “preferred rather than mandatory” also apply to the previously listed product, financial, communication, presentation, and design skill areas?

turns.manager_message: Yes. Product management, Jira project management, technical writing, Figma, Photoshop, and public speaking are each optional and not required at entry. Statistics, A/B testing, Tableau, Power BI, and Excel macros are preferred and can be learned. The only must-haves are the three observable Python, SQL, and REST tasks I just defined.

next_question.question: What are the specific observable Python, SQL, and REST tasks, and what level of completion is required for each on day one?

turns.manager_message: For completeness, R, Java, and C++ are optional; Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD are preferred and learnable; AWS, Azure, and GCP are preferred with any one acceptable; PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka, Airflow, Spark, and Hadoop are preferred exposure only. None of those are day-one requirements.

next_question.question: What observable task and performance standard should the intern meet for each of the Python, SQL, and REST API tasks?
